subject: One-off commercial makegood: GreenFoundry inbound usage dispute — approval required
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@greenfoundry.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected Q3 overage — ask for one-time makegood/credit

Hi Olga —

We just closed our internal review and noticed a ~42% usage spike in the Redwood calls for the week of Sep 6–12. That spike drove our bill up materially compared to the committed monthly target. I attached the usage export and our invoice for the period.

GreenFoundry has been a committed customer, but this overage is a billing shock for our CFO and procurement. We need a one-time commercial gesture while we investigate root cause on our side (likely a batch job misconfiguration).

Can Redwood provide a one-off credit to bring Q3 spend in line with our committed expectation? Preferably a credit that posts to the next invoice while we sort the telemetry. Happy to jump on a quick call.

Attachments: usage_report_20260910.csv, invoice_20260910.pdf

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Customer Success Manager
GreenFoundry Inc.
From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@greenfoundry.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, contracts@greenfoundry.com
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected Q3 overage — ask for one-time makegood/credit

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for sending the data and flagging this early. I pulled the usage and confirmed the spike; it looks like 1 long-running batch job retried at higher concurrency which caused sustained token consumption for ~36 hours.

Proposed commercial response (recommendation for VP/CFO approval):
- One-time credit of $75,000 applied to GreenFoundry's Oct invoice (covers ~70% of the overage above committed usage).
- Require a signed SOW amendment acknowledging the root cause and agreeing to the revised monitoring cadence (30-day tech remediation window).
- Credit is non-refundable, applied as invoice credit in two equal line items across Oct/Nov invoices to ease revenue recognition.

I've included Vivek and Marissa from our side to expedite approvals. If leadership wants a smaller cap, I can offer $50k and add 3 months of free dedicated capacity throttling as a concession.

Next steps for me: await internal signoff, prep amendment + DocuSign, and confirm routing for finance to apply credit.

Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: One-off commercial makegood: GreenFoundry inbound usage dispute — approval required

Olga / Marissa —

I reviewed the usage and the ask. I agree we should grant a one-time concession to preserve the relationship — GreenFoundry is strategic, and a rapid, well-documented response will reduce churn risk. My preference is to structure this as a capped credit rather than an open-ended refund.

Recommendation to leadership: authorize up to $60,000 one-time credit, applied as two $30k credits over the next two invoices, contingent on:
- Signed amendment (& DocuSign) acknowledging remediation plan and telemetry updates;
- Finance confirms recognition treatment;
- Contracts signs off on limitation language.

If Marissa signs off on the $60k cap, I’ll tell Olga to finalize the amendment + get customer consent to the credit mechanics.

-Vivek
VP Sales, Americas
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: One-off commercial makegood: GreenFoundry inbound usage dispute — approval required

Folks —

Approved: cap the one-time commercial makegood at $60,000 subject to the conditions Vivek listed. Finance will process this as an invoice credit applied in two equal line items (Oct & Nov). Legal to circulate the amendment with the following clauses before sending to the customer:
- Customer acknowledgment of root cause and commitment to remediation timeline;
- Credit is non-refundable and will be applied only after signed amendment and customer confirmation of remediation plan;
- Credit offsets future invoices and does not alter underlying pricing or SLAs beyond the documented concession.

Olga: please route the amendment draft to contracts@greenfoundry.com and upload the DocuSign envelope to the HubSpot deal (link below). Finance needs the signed amendment to create the AR credit memo.

I attached a short approval memo for records.

Marissa Cole
CFO
Redwood Inference
Attachment: approval_memo_redwood_60k.pdf
